<?php
$reader = new class {
    public function __get(int|string $incoming) {
        if ($incoming === "12") {
            $incoming = 9;
            return null;
        }
        if ($incoming === "flag") {
            $incoming = null;
            return false;
        }
        if ($incoming === "zero") {
            $incoming = true;
            return -0.0;
        }
        $incoming = false;
        return "0012";
    }
};
$selector = "12";
echo $reader->$selector === null ? "N;" : "BAD_N;";
echo $reader->flag === false ? "F;" : "BAD_F;";
echo $reader->zero;
echo ";";
echo $reader->text;
echo ";";
$reader->flag;
echo $selector === "12" ? "NAME;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";
